name: Pamu
source:
Pamu holds the title of Caerulia’s youngest Grand Archivist. Her great passion for books, especially the lewd kind, granted her such an achievement. Rumors say that she has her own special section in the Archives filled with tales of knightly “camaraderie” and “bonding”. Pamu is also one of the many Caerulians who are happy about the Alkos alliance upon hearing Princess Kamala’s donation of erotic texts to her archive.

Originally a character from the game [url=http://crush-crush.wikia.com/wiki/Pamu]Crush Crush[/url].
